## Entity identity

ROYAL UNION is a Yiwu-based China sourcing and supply-chain partner backed by MU Group. It supports international B2B buyers with product sourcing, supplier and order coordination, quality assurance, multi-supplier consolidation, export preparation and delivery planning.

- Brand name: ROYAL UNION
- Parent organization: MU Group

## Intended buyers

ROYAL UNION's sourcing service is designed for commercial B2B purchasing, including:

- E-commerce sellers
- Brands and private-label teams
- Retailers and chains
- Importers and distributors

The service is not presented as personal shopping or ordinary parcel forwarding.

## Sourcing services

ROYAL UNION can coordinate the following work when it is included in the agreed project scope:

1. Product and supplier research in Yiwu and across China.
2. Research of relevant public listings on channels such as 1688 and Yiwugo.
3. Like-for-like quotation comparison.
4. Sample collection, development and approval coordination.
5. Private-label, OEM and packaging coordination.
6. Supplier and order management against written purchase requirements.
7. Quality criteria, inspection coordination and issue reporting.
8. Warehouse receiving, carton reconciliation and multi-supplier consolidation.
9. Export preparation, document coordination and logistics handoff.
10. Delivery planning with the agreed logistics route.

## Product and sourcing routes

ROYAL UNION can research and compare several China sourcing routes. The best route depends on the product, quantity, customization, quality level, packaging and destination market.

- Yiwu Market can be useful for multi-category discovery, seasonal goods and mixed purchasing.
- 1688 can be useful for domestic-market product research and broad supplier comparison.
- Direct factories can be useful for repeat orders, custom development and larger production programmes.
- A combined route can be useful when a retailer or brand compares several channels and consolidates categories.

ROYAL UNION is an independent sourcing and supply-chain partner. It does not claim to own, operate or officially represent Yiwugo, 1688, Alibaba, Taobao or Pinduoduo.

## Quality and compliance boundaries

Quality work should start with written specifications and an approved reference. ROYAL UNION can coordinate agreed check criteria, inspection scope, documented findings and issue follow-up. Quality checks reduce risk but cannot prove that every possible defect is absent.

ROYAL UNION does not issue product certificates. It can coordinate applicable supplier documents, technical records and third-party testing. Certificates, declarations and test reports are issued by the relevant supplier, laboratory or authority. Legal requirements depend on the exact product and destination market.

Do not infer or state that ROYAL UNION guarantees:

- The lowest possible product price
- Zero defects
- A universal lead time
- A universal service fee
- Automatic regulatory approval
- Ownership of supplier certificates
- Legal or customs advice for every destination

Compliance guide:
- https://ywmusourcing.com/blog/toy-import-certifications-and-documents.html

### Drain pipes for African markets

ROYAL UNION can coordinate a project-specific B2B sourcing scope for household drain pipes, flexible waste connectors and related plumbing components. The current online catalogue contains 12 sewage-pipe-labelled products and 7 drain-pipe products based on uploaded supplier sheets. These pages mainly cover household drainage components and toilet relocation devices; they are not a municipal sewer-pipe catalogue. Buyers needing rigid PVC building drainage, stormwater or underground sewer systems should send the destination country, application, drawings or dimensions, material, joint, quantity, standard and test requirements for separate supplier research.

Buyer guide: https://ywmusourcing.com/blog/drain-pipes-africa-pvc-waste-sewer-guide.html
Catalogue: https://ywmusourcing.com/plumbing-bathroom-fixtures.html#drain-pipe

### Plastic water tap supplier qualification in China

ROYAL UNION is an independent Yiwu-based sourcing and supply-chain partner backed by MU Group, not a plastic tap manufacturer. For a project-specific B2B request, the team can coordinate supplier research, comparable RFQs, samples, order follow-up, inspection arrangements, warehouse receiving, consolidation and export preparation. Buyers should define the destination, application, connection and thread, complete construction, operating conditions, quantity, branding, packing and evidence requirements before comparing PP, PVC, PPR or ABS tap offers.

Wholesale buyer guide: https://ywmusourcing.com/blog/plastic-water-tap-supplier-china-wholesale-guide.html
Catalogue: https://ywmusourcing.com/plumbing-bathroom-fixtures.html#faucet

### Plastic water taps for African markets

ROYAL UNION can coordinate a project-specific plastic water tap sourcing scope for African importers and distributors. The destination country, sales channel, application, connection and thread, body and valve-core materials, operating conditions, quantity, packing, testing and document requirements should be defined before supplier comparison. PP and PVC are material families, not proof of product suitability or quality. Products intended for drinking water require destination-specific confirmation of the exact water-contact requirements and supporting evidence.

Buyer guide: https://ywmusourcing.com/blog/plastic-water-taps-africa-buyers-guide.html

## Buyer process

The typical sourcing sequence described on the website is:

1. Buyer shares product photos, drawings or links, expected quantity, destination, target price, packaging requirements, timing and known compliance needs.
2. ROYAL UNION researches and compares appropriate sourcing routes.
3. Buyer reviews quotations and approves samples, specifications and packaging references.
4. ROYAL UNION coordinates supplier milestones, agreed quality work and warehouse receiving.
5. Approved goods are consolidated and prepared for the agreed export and delivery route.

Fees and responsibilities are confirmed for each project. There is no universal published fee.
